Description

SummaryA single 15.6 cm³ lesion in the left hemisphere.

LocationIt involves the left frontal lobe (23%), insula (16%), deep grey matter (2%) and parietal lobe (2%). It also involves left white matter (11%), mainly the external capsule (25% of it damaged). About half of it (46%) lies outside the named structures: 28% in unnamed white matter, 16% in cortex just outside the named regions and 2% in CSF spaces. In the left frontal lobe it mainly involves the inferior frontal gyrus, pars opercularis (Broca's area; 52% of it damaged) and the precentral gyrus (primary motor cortex; 5% of it damaged).

TissueBy tissue it is cortico-subcortical: cortex (57%), white matter (40%) and deep grey matter (2%).

Vascular territoryIt lies in the left middle cerebral artery (MCA) territory (100%): mainly its frontal part (58%) and insular part (29%), with 9% in the lateral lenticulostriate (deep perforator) territory.

Nearby structuresIt reaches the left Broca's area, left arcuate fasciculus, left corticospinal tract and left primary motor cortex; the left primary auditory cortex is 2 mm away.

Functional areasIt involves structures labelled left Broca's area, left primary motor cortex and left primary somatosensory cortex. These are location labels, not predictions of symptoms.

NetworksBy Yeo-7 functional network (Schaefer parcels), it overlaps the salience / ventral attention network (34% of the lesion), dorsal attention network (12%) and somatomotor network (11%).

Mirror image (homologous region)the same place in the right hemisphere · 0% of the lesion overlaps its own mirror

The lesion flipped across the midline. The homologous region is used as an intact control region (perfusion, thickness, connectivity), and in recovery research, where the undamaged homologue of a damaged area can take over part of its work (for example the right-hemisphere homologue of Broca's area in aphasia).

6Scope and methods

Included: Core morphometry, Mask quality checks, Tissue composition and location classes, Arterial border zones (watershed), Distance to key structures, Mirror image (homologous region), AAL (116 anatomical regions), Schaefer-100 / 7 Networks, Desikan-Killiany-Tourville (DKT31 + CMA), JHU ICBM-DTI-81 white matter, Arterial territories (Johns Hopkins), White-matter tract overlap (proxy), Tract load at cross-sections, Streamline disconnection, Plain-language description.

Not included: Outline sensitivity (not requested); Shape (not requested).

Software: lqtpy 0.7.0, python 3.10.11, numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.12.0, nibabel 5.3.2.

Voxels above the threshold count as lesion. Physical measures use the image affine; region overlap resamples the mask onto each atlas grid (nearest neighbour). Atlases: AAL (Tzourio-Mazoyer 2002), Schaefer-100 (Schaefer 2018), DKT31 (Klein & Tourville 2012), JHU ICBM-DTI-81 (Mori 2008), arterial territories (Liu 2023); tissue classes from DKT31 and the ICBM 2009a white-matter map (Fonov 2011); tracts from HCP842 (Yeh 2018). Location classes, border zones and distances are template-based and approximate. Functional labels describe location only, not symptoms. This report is generated automatically and is not a clinical diagnosis.
